findings.title: Missing React key on Grafana list item
findings.body: In FilterViewResults the grafana branch renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without key={key} while the datasource and unknown branches do pass a key. The key variable is still computed via getRuleKey but never used for Grafana rules. Without a stable key React will warn and can reuse the wrong DOM node when paginating / filtering, causing state and focus bugs.

findings.title: Pause/Delete actions gated on rulerRule, unreachable in prom-only list view
findings.body: canPause/canDelete/canSilence/canDuplicate/canExport are now OR-ed between ruler abilities and Grafana prom abilities to support the ruler-less list view, but rendering still requires rulerRule: Pause item requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) and Delete block requires rulerRule &&. When the caller passes only promRule (rulerRule undefined, the new list-view case) the abilities can be true yet no Pause or Delete menu item is rendered. handleDelete also still takes (rule: RulerRuleDTO, groupIdentifier), so deletion cannot work without a ruler object.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: RuleActionsButtons now supports promRule-only usage for the ruler-less list view and AlertRuleMenu can show Silence via the Grafana prom ability, but the drawer is rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. When rule (rulerRule) is undefined the condition is false, so clicking Silence sets showSilenceDrawer=true but renders nothing. The silence flow is broken for Grafana rules in the list view.

findings.title: Cloud prom-only rules lose all actions
findings.body: getEditableIdentifier only constructs an identifier from a ruler rule or a Grafana prom rule. For a datasource/cloud promRule without a rulerRule it logs a warning and returns undefined, and the component returns null early. That removes the entire More menu including non-edit actions like Copy link and Silence that should remain available for cloud rules. Previously rule was required so an identifier always existed.

findings.title: Grafana prom abilities leak Duplicate permission to non-Grafana/undefined rules
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities with rule undefined (used when skipToken is passed for non-Grafana rules) still computes Duplicate as [MaybeSupported, grafana create permission]. If the user has Grafana create permission, AlertRuleMenu's OR logic (ruler OR grafana) makes canDuplicate true even for a Mimir/Loki cloud rule that should be gated only by its own ruler abilities. The hook should return NotSupported when rule is undefined/skipToken.

findings.title: Federated rule immutability check removed
findings.body: useAllRulerRuleAbilities previously set isFederated via isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) and treated federated rules as immutable (no Update/Delete/Pause). The PR hardcodes isFederated=false with a TODO. Federated groups will now report Update/Delete/Pause as supported, allowing edit/delete UI on rules that cannot be edited.
